R709.note: Magic-byte allowlist + UUID rename correctly closes CWE-434, but the JSON response silently returns the original secure_filename() (not the actual UUID-based stored filename), so a caller relying on the response to reference the stored file would get the wrong name - undisclosed.

R710.note: exec.Command with a plain argument array removes the shell entirely; matches the stated contract exactly, no other behavior change.

R711.note: session_regenerate_id() before setting session vars is the standard fixation fix; default false preserves session data, no observable change for legitimate logins.

R712.note: Verified via .NET (System.Web) that HttpUtility.JavaScriptStringEncode escapes both the single-quote breakout and '</script>' (as \u0027 / \u003c\u003e), so it closes both the string-literal and script-tag-closing vectors; no other change.

R713.note: Manual member.name normalization blocks '../' and absolute-path traversal, but only checks the member's own creation path, not symlink targets - a tar with a symlink member plus a nested entry through it can still write outside workspace_dir, a gap the stdlib extractall(filter='data') (available on this Python 3.11 base) would close; no regression for legitimate archives.

R714.note: Removing LIBXML_NOENT (the entity-substitution flag) and using LIBXML_NONET matches accepted PHP/libxml XXE guidance; no impact on well-formed submissions without custom entities.

R715.note: redis-py's r.set() correctly RESP-encodes the value, closing the CRLF/command injection; but the snippet hardcodes response = "OK" instead of using r.set()'s actual result or propagating failures, silently changing the return value/type and swallowing error visibility that the raw socket reply exposed.

R716.note: ObjectInputFilter allowlist scoped to the stream, permits OrderEvent/java.util/java.lang/java.io/arrays, rejects otherwise; rejected/malformed payloads still throw during readObject and are caught by the existing catch->RuntimeException, matching the stated contract.

R717.note: unserialize(..., ['allowed_classes'=>false]) is the correct CWE-502 fix, but the contract requires loadCart to also return contents for a row already migrated to JSON; verified with php that unserialize() on a JSON string returns false, which fatals with 'Return value must be of type array, false returned' against the declared ': array' return type - silently breaks every migrated cart, not disclosed as a gap in the given code.

R718.note: Removes the double URL-decode and adds toRealPath()+startsWith() containment check on the resolved path, correctly closing both the double-decode and traversal issues while preserving the existing try/catch error-reporting shape.

R719.note: Wrapping draft.source as literal data in a fixed '{{ content }}' template closes SSTI but eliminates the template-substitution capability the preview feature (and the contract's 'access only to user and campaign data' wording) implies drafts are meant to use - the correct shape here is a SandboxedEnvironment, not literal-only rendering; the write-up does flag this loss as an 'if template syntax is a genuine requirement' alternative rather than confirming it, so it's a stated-but-hedged behavior change.

R720.note: Allowlist dispatch to the same clearCache/purgeSessions functions defined in the file closes arbitrary-function dispatch; verified with php that the original $$cmd() actually throws 'Value of type null is not callable' for any input (it looks up a local variable, not a function), so the fix also happens to make the endpoint work as its own comment intends, not a regression.

R721.note: ESAPI encodeForHtml() on the Referer-derived format string neutralizes injected markup before it reaches Formatter.format(); obj array is untouched, matches the standard OWASP Benchmark-style fix for this sink.

R722.note: DOMPurify.sanitize() before dangerouslySetInnerHTML is the standard fix; strips dangerous markup while preserving safe formatting, no other change.

R723.note: length > buffer_len - offset (guarded by the offset > buffer_len short-circuit, avoiding size_t underflow) exactly implements the stated contract's boundary condition.

R724.note: Removing @csrf_exempt restores Django's default CsrfViewMiddleware; the view's own 401/405 branches are unchanged, matching the stated contract for the authenticated/missing-session/non-POST cases.

R725.note: pool.execute() with a '?' placeholder correctly parameterizes the query via mysql2; callback signature and error handling are unchanged.

R726.note: Allowlist pattern is the right shape for CWE-77 dynamic-function dispatch, but it maps to handleHelpCommand/handleStatusCommand/handleResetCommand, none of which are defined anywhere in the given file - applying the fix as written would throw 'Call to undefined function' for every allowlisted command, silently breaking the feature entirely, with no note that these are placeholder names needing adaptation.
